references.text: Describes God's decision to send a flood because of humanity's wickedness, which parallels the sudden destruction mentioned in Matthew 24:39.
Details how the flood wiped out all life on earth, similar to the description of destruction in Matthew 24:39.

By faith Noah was warned about things not yet seen and built an ark to save his family, showing God's rescue of the righteous before destruction, paralleling the idea of being prepared before Christ's return.
Speaks of the Lord's day coming like a thief, when people will be unprepared, just as in Matthew 24:39.
Mocking scoffers will ignore signs of the coming judgment, similar to the ignorance before the flood mentioned in Matthew 24:39.
